scripts.build: npm run build:server && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('server/dist')){ console.error('ERROR: server/dist was not created by tsc'); process.exit(1); }" && npm run copy-server-dist && npm run build:client
scripts.vercel-build: echo '=== build:server ===' && npm run build:server && echo '=== copy-server-dist ===' && npm run copy-server-dist && echo '=== build:client ===' && npm run build:client
scripts.db:push: cd server && npx prisma db push
scripts.db:seed: cd server && npx prisma db seed
scripts.db:seed:neon: cd server && npx prisma db seed
scripts.geocode:ca: cd server && STATE=CA npx tsx scripts/geocode-attractions.ts
scripts.geocode:sandiego: cd server && STATE=CA CITY="San Diego" npx tsx scripts/geocode-attractions.ts
scripts.regeocode-duplicates:ca: cd server && STATE=CA npx tsx scripts/regeocode-duplicate-coords.ts
